From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: IAM evidence & next steps — Orion Bio security review

Hi Lydia — thanks for the questionnaire and the clear priorities. I’ve attached a set of redacted artifacts and links below; happy to walk through anything on the call Thursday at 10:00 AM PT.

High-level answers (quick reference):
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II controls. The full SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA; I’ve provided a redacted summary (SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf) and a secure link to the report (see related_links). If you need the full report, we can execute your NDA or ours — whichever is preferable. Expected turnaround after NDA: 24–48 hours.

- GDPR / HIPAA: We support GDPR compliance controls (data subject requests, DPIA templates) and offer a HIPAA BA arrangement for covered workloads. We also provide VPC private deployments and region controls for data residency.

- SSO / SAML: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP-initiated & SP-initiated). Our standard configuration guide for Okta and Azure AD is attached (sso-saml-config-guide.pdf). We support metadata upload and ACS URL configuration, plus automated attribute mapping for email, name, and groups.

- SCIM provisioning: We provide SCIM v2.0 endpoints for user and group provisioning. SCIM API docs and sample payloads are attached (scim-api-docs.pdf). Provisioning can be enabled per-organization by an org_admin.

- RBAC & admin controls: We use a role-based model with the following built-in roles: org_admin, billing_admin, project_admin, and read_only. A matrix is attached (rbac-matrix.csv) showing permissions by role. Admin actions are logged and surfaced in the Console.

- Audit logs & retention: Audit logs (admin actions, provisioning events, authentication events) are retained for 13 months by default and stored encrypted (KMS-managed) in S3 with integrity checks. I’ve attached a redacted sample (audit-log-sample.json).

Attachments included: SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf, sso-saml-config-guide.pdf, scim-api-docs.pdf, rbac-matrix.csv, audit-log-sample.json

If you prefer we fill out the questionnaire directly, we can return a completed Excel with answers — let me know and we’ll assign it to the security team to complete.

Thanks — look forward to the call Thurs 10:00 AM PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security and Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
